problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents posting videos on social media with zero results

episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her strategy for using YouTube to generate real estate leads by creating search-intent-driven content. She emphasizes the importance of consistency, honesty, and providing real value to potential clients. Sarah also dispels the myth that high production value is necessary, encouraging agents to start with basic equipment and focus on content quality.
